parameters.name: Azimuth
parameters.description: Beam pointing clockwise from north, from gondola yaw angle + 90 deg of CSBFs TDRSS log

parameters.name: Floating_altitude
parameters.description: Balloon floating altitude from onboard GPS sensors

parameters.name: Latitude
parameters.description: Latitude of lidar beam at 82 km altitude, given azimuth, floating altitude and 28 deg off-zenith beam angle

parameters.name: Longitude
parameters.description: Longitude of lidar beam at 82 km altitude, given azimuth, floating altitude and 28 deg off-zenith beam angle

parameters.name: Volume_backscatter_coefficient
parameters.description: volume backscatter coefficient beta derived from Rayleigh lidar data at a threshold of 2.5 sigma above background
